scope: Persistent public Garen physical heading during movement and valid basic/Q attacks
implemented: Garen facing is server-owned physical yaw; no target identity, target coordinates or distance is added to the new field.
Validated yaw reuses the original native FPATAN and quantized matrix arithmetic; finite [-360,0] values are required before mutation.
Reconstructed producer: actual movement, valid attack start and valid windup update the heading; resolution/cancellation retain it.
The client applies the heading on first appearance and subsequent snapshots, including after a hit whose windup was not received.
Known-to-unknown and observed respawn reset the render root to its existing identity default; old packets retain displacement fallback.
Source visibility filtering remains in snapshot_for. Other champions keep their existing producers; Annie W priority/end/movement are regression tested.
The opt-in Garen probe records the actual root quaternion/forward independently of the network heading.

visual_observation.method: Fresh @oai/sky window selection, foreground captures and normal Alt+F4 close
observations: The foreground client displayed the restored textured Twisted Treeline map and two textured Garen models at the normal-command meeting point.
During the gated normal Q sequence, the capture showed one Garen airborne with his sword extended; this transient pose differs from the standing before/after frames.
Both characters remained rendered after the Q/basic sequence; the nearby target health bar was reduced.
The owned client was closed through Alt+F4. The harness recorded both client and server exit code zero, and a fresh Sky window inventory contained no OpenLeague client window.
limits: Three isolated captures do not establish all animation frames, exact blade contact, original BLND transitions or native timing.
Actual root quaternion/target alignment and AnimationPlayer clip progression are supported by the separate runtime trace, not inferred solely from these images.
The close spacing partly overlaps the models in the camera. This is not a qualification of champion collision radii, a complete game, audio or human fidelity acceptance.
Only Garen produces persistent facing in this change. Native attack pivot tick, continuous target tracking and turn speed remain unqualified; the policy is explicitly reconstructed.
The existing identity spawn orientation is not a qualified native spawn direction.
A whole death/respawn cycle missed while both old and new headings are unknown remains indistinguishable from legacy displacement; tests cover observed respawn and known-to-unknown reset.
Root quaternion alignment and actual AnimationPlayer progression are not full skinned-pose, sword contact, BLND transition, audio or human fidelity acceptance.
No damage, cooldown, attack cadence or cancellation policy was changed. The native client cancellation gate alone does not justify rejecting all Move/Stop commands.
One graphical client and five UDP controllers do not qualify six rendered clients, a complete match or all champions.
W texture/material/state work and the native cancellation helper remain separate preparation; the six W effects are not completed by these proofs.
next_action: Integrate and qualify the base Garen W sustained material effect using the prepared original DDS, native selection/restore contracts and per-instance state, preserving fog/skinning/other actors. Continue verified Q timing/cancellation and all other open LoL4.20 requirements; qualify six rendered clients through ordinary combat and victory/results.
